new_entities.name: Front member of upper legform impactor

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: Four transducers shall be installed in the tibia to measure bending moments at the locations within the tibia.
obligations.ears: The flexible lower legform impactor shall have four transducers installed in the tibia to measure bending moments at the locations within the tibia.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: Three transducers shall be installed in the femur to measure bending moments applied to the femur.
obligations.ears: The flexible lower legform impactor shall have three transducers installed in the femur to measure bending moments applied to the femur.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: The measurement axis of each transducer shall be the X-axis of the impactor.
obligations.ears: The measurement axis of each transducer shall be the X-axis of the impactor.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: Three transducers shall be installed in the knee joint to measure elongations of the Medial Collateral Ligament (MCL), Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL), and Posterior Cruciate Ligament (PCL).
obligations.ears: The flexible lower legform impactor shall have three transducers installed in the knee joint to measure elongations of the Medial Collateral Ligament (MCL), Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL), and Posterior Cruciate Ligament (PCL).

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: The measurement locations shall be within ±4 mm along the X-axis from the knee joint centre.
obligations.ears: The knee joint transducer measurement locations shall be within ±4 mm along the X-axis from the knee joint centre.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: shall be 180 for all transducers
obligations.ears: The instrumentation response value Channel Frequency Class (CFC), as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 180 for all transducers.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 400 Nm for the tibia and femur bending moments
obligations.ears: The Channel Amplitude Class (CAC) response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations and 400 Nm for the tibia and femur bending moments.

derived.text: The Channel Amplitude Class (CAC) response value, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 30 mm for the knee ligament elongations.
The Channel Amplitude Class (CAC) response value, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 400 Nm for the tibia and femur bending moments.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be limited to the assessment interval (AI) as defined in paragraph 2.2. of this Regulation
obligations.ears: The determination of all flexible lower legform impactor peak tibia bending moments and ligament elongations shall be limited to the assessment interval (AI) as defined in paragraph 2.2. of this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be rigid, foam covered at the impact side, and 350 mm ± 5 mm long
obligations.ears: The upper legform impactor shall be rigid, foam covered at the impact side, and 350 mm ± 5 mm long (see Figure 4).

derived.text: The upper legform impactor shall be rigid.
The upper legform impactor shall be foam covered at the impact side.
The upper legform impactor shall be 350 mm ± 5 mm long (see Figure 4).

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be 9.5 kg ± 0.1 kg
obligations.ears: The total mass of the upper legform impactor including those propulsion and guidance components which are effectively part of the impactor during the impact shall be 9.5 kg ± 0.1 kg.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be 1.95 kg ± 0.05 kg
obligations.exception: but excluding the foam and skin
obligations.ears: The total mass of the front member and other components in front of the load transducer assemblies, together with those parts of the load transducer assemblies in front of the active elements, but excluding the foam and skin, shall be 1.95 kg ± 0.05 kg.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be mounted to the propulsion system by a torque limiting joint and be insensitive to off-axis loading
obligations.ears: The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be mounted to the propulsion system by a torque limiting joint and be insensitive to off-axis loading.

derived.text: The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be mounted to the propulsion system by a torque limiting joint.
The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be insensitive to off-axis loading.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall move only in the specified direction of impact when in contact with the vehicle and shall be prevented from motion in other directions including rotation about any axis
obligations.ears: When in contact with the vehicle, the impactor shall move only in the specified direction of impact and shall be prevented from motion in other directions including rotation about any axis.

derived.text: When in contact with the vehicle, the impactor shall move only in the specified direction of impact.
When in contact with the vehicle, the impactor shall be prevented from motion in other directions including rotation about any axis.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: shall be set so that the longitudinal axis of the front member is vertical at the time of impact with a tolerance of ±2°, with the joint friction torque set to 675 Nm ± 25 Nm
obligations.ears: The torque limiting joint shall be set so that the longitudinal axis of the front member is vertical at the time of impact with a tolerance of ±2°, with the joint friction torque set to 675 Nm ± 25 Nm.

derived.text: The torque limiting joint shall be set so that the longitudinal axis of the front member is vertical at the time of impact with a tolerance of ±2°.
The torque limiting joint shall be set with the joint friction torque set to 675 Nm ± 25 Nm.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall lie on the longitudinal centre line of the impactor, with a tolerance of ±10 mm
obligations.ears: The centre of gravity of those parts of the impactor which are effectively forward of the torque limiting joint, including any weights fitted, shall lie on the longitudinal centre line of the impactor, with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: The length between the load transducer centre lines shall be 310 mm ± 1 mm and the front member diameter shall be 50 mm ± 1 mm.
obligations.ears: The length between the load transducer centre lines shall be 310 mm ± 1 mm and the front member diameter shall be 50 mm ± 1 mm.

derived.text: The length between the load transducer centre lines shall be 310 mm ± 1 mm.
The front member diameter shall be 50 mm ± 1 mm.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be strain gauged to measure bending moments in three positions, as shown in Figure 4, each using a separate channel
obligations.ears: The front member shall be strain gauged to measure bending moments in three positions, as shown in Figure 4, each using a separate channel.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: Two load transducers shall be fitted to measure individually the forces applied at either end of the upper legform impactor, plus strain gauges measuring bending moments at the centre of the upper legform impactor and at positions 50 mm either side of the centre line
obligations.ears: The upper legform impactor shall have two load transducers fitted to measure individually the forces applied at either end of the upper legform impactor, plus strain gauges measuring bending moments at the centre of the upper legform impactor and at positions 50 mm either side of the centre line (see Figure 4).

derived.text: Two load transducers shall be fitted to measure individually the forces applied at either end of the upper legform impactor.
Strain gauges shall be fitted measuring bending moments at the centre of the upper legform impactor and at positions 50 mm either side of the centre line (see Figure 4).

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: shall be 180 for all transducers
obligations.ears: The instrumentation response value CFC, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 180 for all transducers.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: shall be 10 kN for the force transducers and 1,000 Nm for the bending moment measurements
obligations.ears: The CAC response values, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 10 kN for the force transducers and 1,000 Nm for the bending moment measurements.

derived.text: The CAC response value, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 10 kN for the force transducers.
The CAC response value, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 1,000 Nm for the bending moment measurements.
